$comment: Invariant ids owned by the P2 fix task `p2fix-downstream-validate` (branch p2fix/g6-g9-validate-and-ci). The list is EMPTY and must stay empty: all seven ids the brief names are already claimed by the lanes that wrote their tests — INV-PACK-14 by docs/owned/p2-g5-g6.json, INV-PACK-07 and INV-PACK-50 by p2-g7.json, INV-AUD-08 and INV-PACK-15 by p2-g8.json, INV-PACK-17 and INV-PACK-41 by p2-g9.json — and scripts/coverage-map.ts fails when two ownership files claim the same id. This lane's job on those seven is not to claim them, it is to make them true ON REAL DATA rather than on fixtures and planted defects, which is a property of a build that has not happened yet (see notGreenOnRealData). Re-claiming them here would turn a real ownership map into a collision error and prove nothing.

notGreenOnRealData.$comment: Every one of the seven has an owning pytest test that passes today over the es-mini fixture, a synthetic run directory or a planted defect. Not one has been asserted against a pack this pipeline produced, because `coursekit build es` exits 4 at G5 (docs/P2-BLOCKERS.md B1). The distinction is the whole reason the P2 gate is RED: a validator proven on a planted defect is proven to catch that defect, not proven to have read a real pack.
notGreenOnRealData.INV-PACK-07: tests/test_g7_expand.py + test_validators_exercise.py, over generated items. Unproven: that the real es curriculum's 918 slots produce >= 2 authored forms for every missable item.
notGreenOnRealData.INV-PACK-14: tests/test_g6_validate_language.py, over committed runlog shapes. Unproven: which engines actually ran for es — V8's whole point is that the record names the real engines, and no real G6 run exists to name them.
notGreenOnRealData.INV-PACK-15: tests/test_validators_audio.py, over the COMMITTED content/es/audio-manifest.json (23 clips, 144,694 B). Unproven: the 120 MB budget against a full bank's real bytes.
notGreenOnRealData.INV-PACK-17: tests/test_g9_package.py + test_validators_freelingo.py (F3), over planted rows. Unproven: zero UNRESOLVED licences and an owner string on every attribution-required row of the real ledger. The SCREEN half (S152) has nowhere to be tested at all — see docs/P2-BLOCKERS.md B5.
notGreenOnRealData.INV-PACK-41: tests/test_itemid.py, over hand-built rows. Unproven: id stability across two real rebuilds.
notGreenOnRealData.INV-PACK-50: tests/test_validators_exercise.py, over EC-PACK-47's falsifier. Unproven: that no real grammar-concept item reaches a quoting shape.
notGreenOnRealData.INV-AUD-08: tests/test_cast.py (re-bake key) + the synthetic encode/decode/measure chain in tests/test_g8_bake.py. Unproven: that every clip in a real Kokoro bank measures within tolerance.

Never dispatched, no es-audio-<sha> artefact has ever existed, and docs/ci.md advertised it as bake coverage. The bake runs inside pack-ci.yml's build-es, which has G7's output, the tts group and the same pinned Kokoro weights, and es-build-<sha> (path: build/es) already carries g8/bank/, g8/clips.jsonl and runlog.jsonl. notDone.what: B7 — mutation.yml still produces no score, and dryRunTimeoutMinutes was NOT raised
notDone.why: the 300,000 ms that fires is Vitest's per-test timeout (vitest.config.ts: TEST_TIMEOUT_MS 60_000 x STRYKER_TIMEOUT_FACTOR 5), not stryker.config.json's dryRunTimeoutMinutes: 30 — the local dry run died at 13 m 29 s, well inside 30 minutes, so raising the dry-run budget changes nothing. The timing-out property is a fast-check property in packages/core/src/data/import.test.ts (CI reported INV-DAT-04, the local reproduction INV-DAT-09; neighbours in the same file, same class of failure): 4,350 ms un-instrumented, >300 s under perTest, a >69x execution-mode cost. This lane's file list grants packages/core/src/day/ (DAY), not packages/core/src/data/ (DAT). Different modules. Measured and written into docs/P2-BLOCKERS.md B7 instead of guessed at, and PROPERTY_RUNS was not lowered.
